title: Real-format Irish mobile number baked into unauthenticated demo PDF, breaking the 555 fictional-phone convention
evidence:
server/src/demo/pdf_prebake.gleam:135-137 (added by this diff):
      "2026-08-01T11:20:00Z",
      phone: "087 123 4567",
      tenure: "3 years",

Contrast — every other demo phone in the same file uses the fictional 555 middle triple, e.g. pdf_prebake.gleam:178-179:
      phone: "087 555 0187",
      tenure: "6 years",

The number renders into the committed, publicly-served PDF — pdftotext server/priv/static/demo/report-a-aoife.pdf line 471: "087 123 4567". The PDF is fetched at client/src/demo/demo_api.gleam:404: let url = "/static/demo/report-" <> application_id <> ".pdf" and served unauthenticated by server/src/router.gleam:106-110: http.Get, ["static", ..rest] -> { let safe = list.filter(rest, fn(s) { s != ".." && s != "." }) serve_static(string.join(safe, "/")) }
detail: 087 is a live Irish mobile prefix with no reserved fictional range; 087 123 4567 could be a real subscriber's number, published in a repo file and served at a guessable public URL. Every other demo number uses the 555 fictional marker.
recommended_fix: Switch Aoife's phone to the project's fictional convention (e.g. 087 555 0166) in pdf_prebake.gleam and the matching client fixture in demo_fixtures.gleam, then re-bake the PDFs.
